cues.en: This video uses the magic of computer graphics to show visually how well various voting methods
cues.zh: 这个视频用计算机图形学的魔法，直观展示各种投票方法

cues.en: actually work in terms of electing someone who represents the electorate.
cues.zh: 在选出能代表选民的候选人方面，实际效果到底如何。

cues.en: It turns out our current system
cues.zh: 结果发现，我们当前的制度

cues.en: and a bunch of other proposed systems don't actually do very well in terms of accurately representing the will of voters.
cues.zh: 以及其他一堆被提出的制度，在准确代表选民意愿方面，其实做得并不好。

cues.en: So let's just imagine we have two candidates, you know, your typical red and blue. They're represented by colored circles in this virtual two dimensional political spectrum.
cues.zh: 那我们就假设有两名候选人，就是你熟悉的那种红方和蓝方。在这个虚拟的二维政治光谱里，他们用彩色圆圈表示。

cues.en: Now we'll just add a single voter
cues.zh: 现在只加入一个选民

cues.en: who gets to determine the winner of the election.
cues.zh: 由这个选民来决定选举的赢家。

cues.en: And in this simulation, the voter just picks whichever candidate is closest.
cues.zh: 在这个模拟里，选民只会选离自己最近的候选人。

cues.en: As the voter moves politically closer to the other candidate,
cues.zh: 当这个选民在政治上更靠近另一位候选人时，

cues.en: that candidate becomes the winner.
cues.zh: 那位候选人就会成为赢家。

cues.en: Now we're gonna paint the whole background
cues.zh: 现在我们要把整个背景涂上颜色

cues.en: with whichever candidate would win when the voter is is at each point in the political spectrum. We can add candidates. Now there are three or four or five,
cues.zh: 颜色对应选民处在政治光谱中每个点时，哪位候选人会赢。我们可以增加候选人。现在有三名、四名或五名，

cues.en: and the winner of the election at each point is just whichever candidate is closest to that single voter that's picking the winner.
cues.zh: 而每个点上的选举赢家，就是离那个决定胜负的单个选民最近的那位候选人。

cues.en: As we animate the candidates
cues.zh: 当我们让候选人

cues.en: through the political spectrum,
cues.zh: 在政治光谱中移动起来，

cues.en: this makes for pretty pictures, but it's not particularly useful.
cues.zh: 画面会挺好看，但并不是特别有用。

cues.en: We want to know how voting systems perform when there's more than just one voter.
cues.zh: 我们想知道，当选民不止一个时，投票制度表现如何。

cues.en: So now, instead of just having one voter at each point, we'll run an election of about 4,000 voters arranged in a random Gaussian distribution around that point. So again, the the center of public opinion hasn't changed. There's just now many
cues.zh: 所以现在，不再是每个点只有一个选民，而是在该点周围按随机高斯分布安排约4000名选民来跑一场选举。再说一次，民意中心没有变。只是现在有很多

cues.en: more voters,
cues.zh: 更多选民，

cues.en: and we'll run through a bunch of different voting systems to see how those voting systems perform in terms of creating representative outcomes.
cues.zh: 然后我们会跑一遍一堆不同的投票制度，看看这些制度在产生有代表性的结果方面表现如何。

cues.en: We'll look at a few different ones. So plurality,
cues.zh: 我们来看几个不同的例子。首先是多样性，

cues.en: that's the current system that we use
cues.zh: 这就是我们目前使用的系统

cues.en: here in The US and in most
cues.zh:
在美国和大多数地区
@@ο

cues.en: venues. We'll also look at instant runoff voting. Sometimes people call that ranked choice voting.
cues.zh: 投票场所。我们还会看看即时决选投票，有时人们称之为排序选择投票。

cues.en: It's used in about a dozen cities in The US, and Maine just passed it statewide.
cues.zh: 它被美国大约十几个城市采用，而且缅因州刚刚在全州范围内通过了这项法案。

cues.en: We'll look at score voting.
cues.zh: 我们将探讨打分投票制。

cues.en: So ranked choice lets you rank candidates one to three.
cues.zh: 所以按需排位投票法允许你按一到三的顺序对候选人进行排序。

cues.en: Score voting lets you score them.
cues.zh: 评分投票允许你为它们打分。

cues.en: Zero to five or zero to nine.
cues.zh: 从零到五或从零到九。

cues.en: And then finally, we'll look at score runoff voting, also known as star voting,
cues.zh: 最后，我们来看分数决选投票，也称为星级投票，

cues.en: which starts
cues.zh: 它开始了

cues.en: with score voting and then adds an automatic runoff step to correct distortion.
cues.zh: 采用评分投票，然后加入自动决选步骤来纠正失真。

cues.en: So as you can see with two candidates,
cues.zh: 所以正如你所看到的，对于两个候选者，

cues.en: all of the voting methods behave the same and produce results that make sense.
cues.zh: 所有的投票方法表现都一样，并且会产生合乎情理的结果。

cues.en: In all the systems, the candidate closest to the center of public opinion
cues.zh: 在所有的系统中，最接近公众舆论中心的候选人

cues.en: wins, which means,
cues.zh: 获胜，这意味着，

cues.en: which which matches
cues.zh: 哪一个匹配

cues.en: what would happen if there's just a single voter right at the center of public opinion.
cues.zh: 如果公众舆论的正中心只有一位选民，会发生什么？

cues.en: What happens when we add a third candidate? Well, shit breaks. Turns out creating a voting method that is actually representative
cues.zh: 当我们引入第三个候选人时会发生什么？好吧，彻底崩了。事实证明，要创建一个真正具有代表性的投票方法

cues.en: is a nontrivial task every time there are more than two candidates.
cues.zh: 每次候选者超过两个，这都不是件简单的事。

cues.en: Plurality voting can easily squeeze out a candidate in the middle of the field. You can see that the win region for this yellow candidate is dramatically diminished.
cues.zh: 相对多数制很容易把处于中间位置的候选人挤出去。你可以看到，这位黄色候选人的获胜区域明显缩小了。

cues.en: That candidate doesn't even win in elections
cues.zh: 那位候选人连选举都赢不了。

cues.en: when when they're right at the very center of public opinion
cues.zh: 当他们正处在舆论的最中心时

cues.en: because of where they are relative to the other candidates.
cues.zh: 因为它们相对于其他候选项所处的位置。

cues.en: This is this is a very visual way to demonstrate what... What's known as the spoiler effect, where the presence of a a spoiler candidate in the race can prevent the candidate who otherwise should have won from winning.
cues.zh: 这是一种非常直观的方式来演示……也就是所谓的“破坏者效应”，即竞选中如果有破坏者候选人存在，就会阻止本该获胜的候选人赢得选举。

cues.en: So you can see that when the electorate is closer to yellow
cues.zh: 所以你可以看到，当选民更倾向于黄色，

cues.en: on the blue side of the red blue divide, red acts as a spoiler. And when the electorate is closer to yellow on the red side,
cues.zh: 并且位于红蓝阵营的蓝色一侧时，红色就起到了破坏者作用。而当选民更倾向于黄色，且位于红色一侧时，

cues.en: blue acts as a spoiler.
cues.zh: 蓝色就起到了破坏者作用。

cues.en: In both cases, preventing the most representative candidate
cues.zh: 在这两种情况下，都阻碍了最具代表性的候选人

cues.en: from winning.
cues.zh: 赢得胜利。

cues.en: Right choice voting has much of the same spoiler center squeeze dynamic that plagues our current voting system.
cues.zh: 选择投票制（Right choice voting）存在着与我们现行投票系统困扰相同的“破坏者-中心挤压”动态。

cues.en: Because of the peculiar way instant runoff is tabulated,
cues.zh: 由于即时决胜制（instant runoff）独特的计票方式，

cues.en: the second choices of only some of the voters are taken into account.
cues.zh: 只有部分选民的第二选择被纳入了考量。

cues.en: Far from being a cure for the fundamental ill of our democratic process, instant runoff simply hides the problem behind a complex and error prone counting mechanism.
cues.zh: 即时决胜制不仅远未能治愈我们民主进程的根本顽疾，反而只是将问题隐藏在了一个复杂且容易出错的计票机制背后。

cues.en: Score voting actually has the opposite effect.
cues.zh: 记分投票制（Score voting）实际上有着相反的效果。

cues.en: Candidates actually benefit
cues.zh: 候选人实际上会因为

cues.en: by being politically in between
cues.zh: 在政治立场上处于其他候选人

cues.en: the other candidates.
cues.zh: 之间而受益。

cues.en: This center expansion
cues.zh: 这种“中心扩张”

cues.en: can likewise often result in candidates losing
cues.zh: 同样经常导致候选人落败，

cues.en: even when public opinion is centered directly on them.
cues.zh: 哪怕公众舆论的焦点明明就在他们身上。

cues.en: Star voting
cues.zh: STAR投票制

cues.en: corrects the distortion present in score voting and consistently comes closest to the ideal one voter model.
cues.zh: 纠正了记分投票制中存在的扭曲，并且始终最接近理想的“一人一票”模型。

cues.en: As we add more candidates,
cues.zh: 随着我们增加更多候选人，

cues.en: the problems with plurality,
cues.zh: 多票制、

cues.en: IRV, and score become more pronounced to the point where IRV in particular produces just these really strange results. And now we'll look at these images again,
cues.zh: IRV和记分投票制的问题就会变得更加明显，以至于IRV在某些情况下会产生极其诡异的结果。现在我们再次回顾这些图像，

cues.en: highlighting the areas that are different from the ideal model. So we can see really clearly where they fail.
cues.zh: 高亮显示出与理想模型不同的区域。这样我们就能非常清楚地看到它们在何处失效。

cues.en: The intensity
cues.zh: 强度

cues.en: of the different image is based on how much the voting system got it wrong. So green means that it, you know, kind of picked a candidate that's pretty close to the right candidate.
cues.zh: 不同图像的颜色取决于投票系统错得有多离谱。所以绿色表示它选出的候选项离正确候选项比较接近。

cues.en: Red means just picked... There was a much better candidate,
cues.zh: 红色表示刚刚选中……其实有更好的候选，

cues.en: much closer to the center of public opinion that the system missed. And once again, you can see the serious problems present, particularly in plurality and instant runoff,
cues.zh: 比系统所忽视的公众舆论中心要近得多。再一次，你能看到存在的严重问题，特别是在多元制和即时决胜选举中，

cues.en: less for score, and substantially diminished in star voting.
cues.zh: 得分更低，在星级投票中也大幅减少。

cues.en: This visualization begins to get at the much more sophisticated
cues.zh: 这个可视化开始展现出远为复杂的

cues.en: voting method simulation
cues.zh: 投票方法模拟

cues.en: work,
cues.zh: 工作，

cues.en: such as Warren Smith's Bayesian regret models or Jameson Quinn's voter satisfaction efficiency,
cues.zh: 比如 Warren Smith 的贝叶斯遗憾模型，或者 Jameson Quinn 的选民满意度效率，

cues.en: where where they have much more complex distributions of voters
cues.zh: 而那里的选民分布要复杂得多

cues.en: and and strategy
cues.zh: 策略与策略

cues.en: models where you have a certain number of voters behaving strategically and not. What's interesting about that is that those simulations,
cues.zh: 在那些模型中，有一定数量的投票者采取策略性行为，而另一些则不采取。有趣的是，那些模拟，

cues.en: those much more sophisticated simulations,
cues.zh: 那些复杂得多的模拟，

cues.en: actually come up with very similar results
cues.zh: 其实得出了非常相似的结果

cues.en: in terms of the four systems presented here.
cues.zh: 就这里介绍的四套系统而言。
